infrastructure: North Macedonia has reasonable urban internet connectivity, with EU-supported infrastructure improvement ongoing.
Fixed and mobile broadband penetration is improving, particularly in Skopje.
talent: Ss. Cyril and Methodius University in Skopje has computer science programmes with limited AI research output.
An IT outsourcing sector is developing, creating some applied tech skills.
Brain drain to EU countries and North America is significant.
governance: NATO and EU accession candidate status drives governance reform aligned with Euro-Atlantic standards.
Data protection law aligned with GDPR; the Directorate for Personal Data Protection is active.
Political stability has improved after the 2018 Prespa Agreement resolved the naming dispute.
investment: EU pre-accession IPA funds are the primary source of digital transformation investment.
Limited foreign direct investment in AI-specific sectors.
IT outsourcing is the most internationally integrated sector.
economic_readiness: One of the smaller Western Balkans economies with limited domestic AI adoption capacity.
IT services sector is growing and providing foreign exchange earnings.
Low GDP per capita constrains enterprise and consumer AI spending.
